note: Regional screening: slope of a fitted elevation plane and RMS height remaining after removing that plane, from up to 25 samples spaced 30 km across a 120 km region. This does not measure rocks, wheel-scale traversability, antenna visibility or a radio link budget. Earth uses only nonnegative land elevations, requiring at least 13 of 25 samples and a solvable plane; this excludes bathymetry and can exclude below-sea-level land. Bare ground is the 2019 Copernicus regional cover fraction; polar areas outside its coverage remain missing. Weights, tolerances and sampling choices are defaults, not validated engineering limits.
bareGroundAttribution: Buchhorn, M., et al. (2020). Copernicus Global Land Service: Land Cover 100m, Collection 3, epoch 2019, V3.0.1. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.3939050.
missingReason: No regional sample: fewer than 13 usable land elevations, invalid source data, or outside 2019 bare-ground coverage.
